citations.assessment: The consulted digital Vayikra Rabbah reads bar Chaggai. Heilprin reports bar Chanai. The exact underlying printed witness remains open.
The digital Shir HaShirim Rabbah reads bar Hadrin in a parallel raven-wing exposition and names Alexandri Kerova alongside him.
Mattanot Kehunnah explicitly gives the public prayer leader who recites piyyutim and kerovot explanation in the Vayikra Rabbah commentary.
